scenario.shared_setting: Four colleagues work as a small team in an office and have worked together for two years. You all know each other's faith and what each of you eats: Hafiz is Muslim and eats halal, Farah is Muslim and eats halal, Zarina is Muslim and eats halal, and Priya is Hindu and does not eat beef. A client pitch is due on Thursday at 9 a.m., two days from now. Each of the four owns one section of it, and Priya's analysis section is about half done. Nobody outside the four knows the work well enough to help before Thursday. It is Tuesday morning and all four are in the team room.
